task: Reject registration with HTTP 422 when the email address is not a valid email address.
Reject registration with HTTP 422 when the password is shorter than 8 characters.
Reject registration with HTTP 409 when the email address is already registered.
Add GET /users/{user_id} that returns the user's id and email as JSON, or HTTP 404 if no user has that id.
Add DELETE /users/{user_id} that removes the user and returns HTTP 204, or HTTP 404 if no user has that id.
Add GET /health that returns HTTP 200 with the JSON body {"status": "ok"}.
Add GET /users/count that returns JSON of the form {"count": N}, where N is the number of registered users.
Store and return email addresses in lower case with surrounding whitespace removed.
